featured_reviews.name: TripperHD Vlogs
featured_reviews.review_text:
Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank is a state-of-the-art facility located in Charni Road, Mumbai, India. It is licensed by the Central Drugs Standard Control Organization (CDSCO) for the collection, testing, processing, and storage of blood and blood components. The blood bank is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and provides services to patients at Saifee Hospital and other hospitals in the Mumbai area.

Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank collects 100% voluntary blood donations. All blood donors are screened for eligibility and their blood is tested for a variety of diseases, including HIV, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, syphilis, and malaria. The blood bank also uses the latest technology to process and store blood safely and effectively.

Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank provides a wide range of blood and blood components, including:

Whole blood
Packed red cells
Saline-washed red cells
Fresh frozen plasma
Random platelet concentrate
Cryoprecipitate
Leucodepleted single donor platelet by plateletpheresis
Leukocytes by leukopheresis
Single donor plasma by plasmapheresis

The blood bank also provides a number of other services, such as:

Blood compatibility testing
Transfusion counseling
Blood component therapy
Blood product storage and transportation
Saifee Hospital Trust Blood Bank is committed to providing high-quality blood and blood components to patients in need. The blood bank has a team of experienced and qualified staff who are dedicated to ensuring the safety and efficacy of the blood products they supply.

Established by the Dawoodi Bohra community, the hospital is equipped with state-of-the-art facilities and a dedicated medical staff. Saifee Hospital is known for its comprehensive range of medical specialties, cutting-edge technology, and a patient-centric approach. The hospital has earned a reputation for excellence in various medical fields, including surgery, cardiology, oncology, and obstetrics. With a focus on delivering compassionate and advanced medical care, Saifee Hospital stands as a pillar of health in the bustling city of Mumbai, catering to the diverse healthcare needs of the community it serves.

featured_reviews.name: Suraaj Dubey
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited the hospital for blood donation with a genuine intention to help others. During the screening, I was told that my hemoglobin level was low. However, after further tests, everything came out normal and there was no health issue found.

I feel the staff handling the blood donation process need better training and proper knowledge. Hiring inexperienced staff without enough medical understanding can create unnecessary fear and confusion for donors. Because of this, people who come forward for a good cause may feel discouraged from donating blood again.

I hope the hospital management improves staff training and ensures accurate guidance is given to donors in the future.

featured_reviews.name: रुबाब FASHION HUB'S
featured_reviews.review_text:
The staff at this blood bank are very useless and have very low level of ideology. I was sent by the doctor at Satabdi Hospital to help an elderly man and ordered emergency blood. They delayed the payment for a long time. When I was making the payment, I was given a cash payment. There is no change for 500 rs in such a big blood bank. They made me check it from the shop next door. The staff is very terrible in such an emergency.

Very bad service

featured_reviews.name: Ashish Limaye
featured_reviews.review_text: They are a shame on humanity. They take a non refundable deposit of ₹450 , do not give receipt, no terms clearly explained. My dad was being operated upon in SUVARNA Hospital Borivali west and we had requested for reservation of blood on 19.03.2026. Fortunately we did not need blood on 20.03 and 21.03 but we were in need of blood unit for 22.03.2026.When we called them, they said it is over 24 hours so you will have to pay deposit again . Basically a con game to get ₹450 as advance and refuse to accept it later ( within 48 hours). This is absolute inhuman behaviour from the blood bank. They will have a curse of a million people if they continue to operate with such foolish money mindset with no respect to customer inconvenience and do not bother to give any receipts or  explain these terms before making reservation. They should be closed down on unethical business practices.
